title: Paloma Top-Up & Bill Pay Coverage Schedule: Corridors and Partner Operators
content:
Paloma Top-Up & Bill Pay can be ordered only in the corridors listed for each product below, and only for the operators or billers Paloma pays for that product in that corridor. A corridor or an operator that is not listed against a product is not served for that product.

## Corridors served, by product

| Product | Corridors served |
|---|---|
| Paloma Airtime Top-Up | MX-MXN, GT-GTQ, SV-USD, HN-HNL, DO-DOP, CO-COP, PH-PHP, IN-INR, VN-VND, BD-BDT, NG-NGN, KE-KES, GH-GHS (13 corridors) |
| Paloma Data Bundle | MX-MXN, GT-GTQ, SV-USD, HN-HNL, DO-DOP, CO-COP, PH-PHP, IN-INR, VN-VND, BD-BDT, NG-NGN, KE-KES, GH-GHS (13 corridors) |
| Paloma Electricity Token | KE-KES, NG-NGN, GH-GHS |
| Paloma Bill Pay Utilities | MX-MXN, GT-GTQ, SV-USD, HN-HNL, DO-DOP, CO-COP, PH-PHP |
| Paloma Bill Pay Television | MX-MXN, CO-COP, PH-PHP, NG-NGN, GH-GHS, KE-KES |
| Paloma Bill Pay School Fees | PH-PHP, IN-INR, NG-NGN |

## Operators and billers paid, by product and corridor

| GT-GTQ (Guatemala) | Tigo Guatemala, Claro Guatemala |
| SV-USD (El Salvador) | Tigo El Salvador, Claro El Salvador |
| HN-HNL (Honduras) | Tigo Honduras, Claro Honduras |
| DO-DOP (Dominican Republic) | Claro Dominican Republic, Altice Dominican Republic |
| CO-COP (Colombia) | Claro Colombia, Movistar Colombia, Tigo Colombia |
| PH-PHP (Philippines) | Globe, Smart, DITO |
| IN-INR (India) | Jio, Airtel India, Vi |
| VN-VND (Vietnam) | Viettel, VinaPhone, MobiFone |
| BD-BDT (Bangladesh) | Grameenphone, Robi, Banglalink |
| NG-NGN (Nigeria) | MTN Nigeria, Airtel Nigeria, Glo |
| KE-KES (Kenya) | Safaricom, Airtel Kenya |

## Reading the schedule

- Both the corridor and the operator must match the product: Safaricom appears under KE-KES for Paloma Airtime Top-Up and Paloma Data Bundle, but Kenya's only electricity distributor in this schedule is KPLC Prepaid, and Kenya's only pay-TV biller is DStv Kenya.
- Example (hypothetical request): a Paloma Bill Pay Utilities payment to a Ghana biller cannot be ordered, because GH-GHS is not a corridor served by Paloma Bill Pay Utilities; GH-GHS is served for Paloma Airtime Top-Up, Paloma Data Bundle, Paloma Electricity Token and Paloma Bill Pay Television.
- Example (hypothetical request): a Paloma Bill Pay School Fees payment in IN-INR is paid to BBPS Education; a Paloma Bill Pay School Fees payment in MX-MXN cannot be ordered, as MX-MXN is not a School Fees corridor.
